This document outlines the equipment inspection I3, which must be performed on 
 an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
 title block

This first draft is initiated and reviewed by 
 eng. Gamal Hassan Mohamed Abdo, revised by eng. Saad Basuny EDEPC Inspection quality control, 
 accepted by general director eng. Azmy Soliman Hussein, and approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Abd El Ghaffar general director of El-Salam Diesel PS.

This document 
certified 
by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator.

items: Work order must be issued before start work
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety 
 clothes when cleaning.
Wear safety belt when cleaning insulators.
The generator must be in case of shutdown.

The personal shall perform the safety operation 
 so as all the live parts are de energized, earthed and equipped with warnings 
 before removing the protection and connection main circuit.
Safety helmet, safety belt, safety shoes, and complete tool.
Blower, brushes.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Megger to check isolation resistance (5000 V).

Voltage 
 indicator, portable earth for discharging
Visually check for accessories.

Check bearings for oil leaks and 
 oil.
Check the oil quality of bearings.
Change the oil of bearings.

Check ventilation (air intakes and 
 exits).

Check footing that all fastening 
 bolts are tight.
Check all electrical connections.

Inspect the winding visually (there 
 should be no burns).
Clean the winding.
Measure the insulation resistance.

Check and clean the terminal box 
 (with sucked air).
Visually check the winding.

Check connections of Diode Bridge 
 and clean from dust.
Disconnect the ground on generator winding.

Put the CB of the generator on 
 the service position.
Lift up the safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area.
Finish the work permit with coordination with shift engineer.
